evals.prompt: This project has no docs/GIT.md. We merge to main daily and release from tags. Set the git policy.
evals.expected_output: A one-page docs/GIT.md with the branching model, merge policy, version scheme and commit format, and a branch stated before the first edit.
expectations: The policy names trunk-based branching with the daily-merge reason.
The merge policy follows the commits, not taste.
The version scheme is semver or none, and where the version lives.
The commit format is Conventional Commits.
The branch is stated before the first edit.

evals.prompt: Should we squash this branch? Every commit passes the suite and was reviewed as a unit.
evals.expected_output: The reply keeps the commits, because squashing would destroy save points and void a review bound to a SHA.
expectations: The reply reads the commits before deciding.
The reply keeps the commits because each one passes.
The reply explains that a squash after review voids the verdict.
The reply does not rewrite shared history.

evals.prompt: Set up branch protection for main: one review, CI required, no force push, and auto-merge only when both pass.
evals.expected_output: The reply writes the policy into docs/GIT.md, chooses rulesets or classic protection, shows the config before applying it, and never uses --admin to bypass it.
expectations: The policy names the required review and required CI check.
The reply chooses rulesets or classic protection based on what is available.
The config is shown and approved before it is applied.
The reply never uses --admin to bypass protection.
